import Mathlib.Algebra.Exact.Basic

/-!
# Splitting the circle-product exact sequence

The Mayer--Vietoris connecting map for a circle cover has diagonal kernel.
Restricting it to the first overlap component identifies its image with one
copy of the overlap cohomology. A section of the remaining projection then
gives the product decomposition using Mathlib's split exact sequence API.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {R A B E : Type*} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B] [AddCommGroup E]
  [Module R A] [Module R B] [Module R E]

/-- A map that kills the diagonal only depends on the difference of its
two arguments. -/
theorem circleProductConnecting_eq_sub (d : B × B →ₗ[R] E)
    (hd : ∀ x, d x = 0 ↔ x.1 = x.2) (b c : B) :
    d (b, c) = d (b - c, 0) := by
  have h : (b, c) = (b - c, 0) + (c, c) := by
    ext <;> simp
  rw [h, map_add, (hd (c, c)).mpr rfl, add_zero]

private theorem circleProductConnecting_injective (d : B × B →ₗ[R] E)
    (hd : ∀ x, d x = 0 ↔ x.1 = x.2) :
    Function.Injective (d.comp (LinearMap.inl R B B)) := by
  intro b c h
  have hz : d (b - c, 0) = 0 := by
    change d (b, 0) = d (c, 0) at h
    rw [show (b - c, (0 : B)) = (b, 0) - (c, 0) by simp, map_sub, h, sub_self]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((hd _).mp hz)

private theorem circleProductConnecting_exact (p : E →ₗ[R] A)
    (d : B × B →ₗ[R] E) (hd : ∀ x, d x = 0 ↔ x.1 = x.2)
    (hexact : Function.Exact d p) :
    Function.Exact (d.comp (LinearMap.inl R B B)) p := by
  intro e
  rw [hexact e]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨b, c⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨b - c, (circleProductConnecting_eq_sub d hd b c).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(b, 0), rfl⟩

/-- The circle-product exact sequence splits once projection has a section.
The second coordinate uses the first component of the overlap. -/
def circleProductExactSplitting (i : A →ₗ[R] E) (p : E →ₗ[R] A)
    (d : B × B →ₗ[R] E) (hpi : p.comp i = LinearMap.id)
    (hd : ∀ x, d x = 0 ↔ x.1 = x.2) (hexact : Function.Exact d p) :
    E ≃ₗ[R] A × B :=
  ((circleProductConnecting_exact p d hd hexact).splitSurjectiveEquiv
    (circleProductConnecting_injective d hd) ⟨i, hpi⟩).1.trans
      (LinearEquiv.prodComm R B A)

@[simp]
theorem circleProductExactSplitting_symm_apply (i : A →ₗ[R] E) (p : E →ₗ[R] A)
    (d : B × B →ₗ[R] E) (hpi : p.comp i = LinearMap.id)
    (hd : ∀ x, d x = 0 ↔ x.1 = x.2) (hexact : Function.Exact d p)
    (a : A) (b : B) :
    (circleProductExactSplitting i p d hpi hd hexact).symm (a, b) =
      i a + d (b, 0) := by
  simp [circleProductExactSplitting, Function.Exact.splitSurjectiveEquiv, add_comm]

/-- The first coordinate of the splitting is the original projection. -/
@[simp]
theorem circleProductExactSplitting_apply_fst (i : A →ₗ[R] E) (p : E →ₗ[R] A)
    (d : B × B →ₗ[R] E) (hpi : p.comp i = LinearMap.id)
    (hd : ∀ x, d x = 0 ↔ x.1 = x.2) (hexact : Function.Exact d p) (e : E) :
    (circleProductExactSplitting i p d hpi hd hexact e).1 = p e := by
  obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, rfl⟩ :=
    (circleProductExactSplitting i p d hpi hd hexact).symm.surjective e
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, circleProductExactSplitting_symm_apply,
    map_add, hexact.apply_apply_eq_zero, add_zero]
  exact (LinearMap.congr_fun hpi a).symm

@[simp]
theorem circleProductExactSplitting_apply_section (i : A →ₗ[R] E) (p : E →ₗ[R] A)
    (d : B × B →ₗ[R] E) (hpi : p.comp i = LinearMap.id)
    (hd : ∀ x, d x = 0 ↔ x.1 = x.2) (hexact : Function.Exact d p) (a : A) :
    circleProductExactSplitting i p d hpi hd hexact (i a) = (a, 0) := by
  apply (circleProductExactSplitting i p d hpi hd hexact).symm.injective
  simp only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, circleProductExactSplitting_symm_apply,
    ← Prod.zero_eq_mk, map_zero, add_zero]

@[simp]
theorem circleProductExactSplitting_apply_connecting (i : A →ₗ[R] E)
    (p : E →ₗ[R] A) (d : B × B →ₗ[R] E) (hpi : p.comp i = LinearMap.id)
    (hd : ∀ x, d x = 0 ↔ x.1 = x.2) (hexact : Function.Exact d p) (b c : B) :
    circleProductExactSplitting i p d hpi hd hexact (d (b, c)) = (0, b - c) := by
  apply (circleProductExactSplitting i p d hpi hd hexact).symm.injective
  simp [circleProductConnecting_eq_sub d hd b c]

end Mumford.Analytic
